# BVN — Global Marketing & Operations Automation Agency

> BVN is a global digital marketing and business automation agency trusted by 238+ clients worldwide, founded by Benjamin Vincent Yson and based in Las Piñas, Metro Manila, Philippines. BVN helps businesses scale through marketing excellence (social media, SEO, content, web) and intelligent operations automation (CRM, AI agents, HR & payroll) — serving clients internationally and locally in the Philippines. Contact: bvn@bvnofficial.com | +63-981-655-6555.
